chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-'Abbas ibn Musa, from Yunus ibn 'Abd al-Rahman, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, from al-Mu'alla ibn Khunays, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about a man who had intercourse with his wife, then she transferred his semen to a virgin slave-girl and she became pregnant. He عليه السلام said: "The child belongs to the man; upon the woman is rajm, and upon the slave-girl is the hadd."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman transfers her husband's semen to another woman and pregnancy results?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام concerning lineage and penal consequences in an unusual case involving transfer of semen resulting in pregnancy. It establishes the child's attribution to the man and specifies distinct hadd punishments for the two women involved.
